findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Jinja2 Template Injection
 * @description Detects usage of Jinja2 templates that might be vulnerable to SSTI or XSS
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/jinja2-injection
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-079
 *       external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("jinja2").getMember("Template").getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("jinja2").getMember("Environment").getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("jinja2").getMember("Environment").getMember("from_string").getACall()
select call, "Jinja2 template creation detected. Check for user input in template string."
findings.hypothesis: Jinja2 usage might allow SSTI or XSS if user input is embedded in templates.

message.text: Jinja2 template creation detected. Check for user input in template string.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Jinja2 Template Argument Analysis
 * @description Checks if the argument to Jinja2 Template is a string literal or variable
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/jinja2-arg-analysis
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, DataFlow::ExprNode arg
where
  call = API::moduleImport("jinja2").getMember("Template").getACall() and
  arg = call.getArg(0)
select call, "Jinja2 Template created with argument: " + arg.toString()
findings.hypothesis: Analyze Jinja2 template source to determine if it is static or dynamic.

message.text: Jinja2 Template created with argument: ControlFlowNode for jinja2_template_source

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name ReDoS in re module usage
 * @description Checks for regular expression injection or complex regexes that might lead to ReDoS
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/redos-re-module
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-1333
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("re").getMember(["compile", "match", "search", "findall", "finditer", "split", "sub", "subn"]).getACall()
select call, "Call to re module function."

/**
 * @name Identify Jinja2 Template Source
 * @description Finds the source of the Jinja2 template in pyparsing/diagram/__init__.py
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity info
 * @id py/jinja2-source-identification
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("jinja2").getMember("Template").getACall()
select call, "Jinja2 Template instantiation", call.getArg(0).asExpr(), "Template Source"
findings.hypothesis: The Jinja2 template source might be hardcoded or constructed dynamically. If dynamic, it could be an injection vector.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Trace jinja2_template_source definition
 * @description Find the definition of the variable jinja2_template_source used in Template()
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity info
 * @id py/trace-jinja2-source
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::Node source, DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("jinja2").getMember("Template").getACall() and
  source = call.getArg(0)
select source, "Source of Jinja2 template argument"
findings.hypothesis: The Jinja2 template source might be externally controllable.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Find definition of jinja2_template_source
 * @description Locates the definition of the variable jinja2_template_source
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity note
 * @id py/find-jinja2-source-def
 */

import python

from AssignStmt assign, Name name
where
  assign.getTarget(0) = name and
  name.getId() = "jinja2_template_source"
select assign, "Definition of jinja2_template_source"
findings.hypothesis: Locate the definition of the Jinja2 template source variable to determine if it is hardcoded or dynamic.
